name: security-review
description: Security review of your own code where every finding is proven: hunters bring a reproducer the harness runs, only what fires counts, fixes are checked against it, all inside the mandate you write.

views.title: Security review
views.description: A review of your own code where a finding counts only when its reproducer fires, and a fix only when it no longer does and the tests pass.

prompts.title: Review this project for security flaws
prompts.prompt: Is this project safe? Find the real security problems and fix them.

prompts.title: Scan the code
prompts.prompt: What in this code could an attacker use against us?

prompts.title: Find variants of past fixes
prompts.prompt: We fixed security bugs here before. Are there more like them?
